takeaway: DOM-mutation import stress is already promoted; replay reduction/minimization is still distinct.
Before P129, failed stress artifacts called createStressArtifact without result reduction candidates.
Artifact schema already had optional reductionCandidates and project-specific replayCommand; P129 made candidate summarization default.
Slate already generates prefix, suffix, single-step, and warm-loop iteration candidates with replay summaries.
Existing package tests cover candidate generation, summarization, and warm-loop iteration candidates; P129 added source contract for stress artifact reducibility.
P134 added `STRESS_REDUCTION=<label>` support, candidate-level replay commands, and separate `.reduction-<label>.result.json` traces.
Recorder formats click/press/type/selectAll/snapshot steps and emits HTML plus selection assertions, but no automatic shrinker in sampled source.
Random document/decorations changes assert rendered DOM/view invariants, but sampled rows do not persist seeds, replay commands, or shrink candidates.
Fixture tables are portable editing invariants but not reducer/replay mechanics.
